faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Avadi?

faq.q: Is investing in plots in Avadi a good long-term decision?

faq.q: What is the plot appreciation rate in Avadi?

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying land in Avadi?
faq.a: 7% of the market value for plots above ₹10 lakh, plus a 1% registry fee under Tamil Nadu rules. Women buyers receive a 1% rebate on CMDA-approved plots.

faq.q: Are plots in Avadi CMDA or DTCP approved?
faq.a: All OmShakthy plots in Avadi are fully CMDA and DTCP certified, ensuring legal layouts, clear titles, and infrastructure compliance.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Avadi?
faq.a: CMDA/DTCP approval, encumbrance certificate (last 30 years), patta/chitta extract, sale deed, and survey sketch.

faq.q: How to avoid fraud when buying a plot in Avadi?
faq.a: Deal only with reputed developers, insist on site visits, get third-party legal checks, avoid cash deals, and run an encumbrance certificate search.
